{{Quote|Military research, organized like an insect's hive of divisions and subdivisions with their own would-be queens.|Imperial Doctor Eckard Lokin explains the bureau's role to Cipher Nine|<ref name="KtL" />}}
The '''Imperial Science Bureau''', also known as the '''Imperial Science Corps''', was an organization of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] dedicated to research and development of new technology. It held a significant amount of influence in order to achieve its aims through other agencies within the Empire.

Multiple divisions comprised the organization including the [[Geo-Engineering Corps]],<ref name="ST" /> [[New Thinking Division]],<ref name="AWA" /> [[Project Chimera]],<ref name="PC" /> [[Project Cicerone]], [[Project Harvest]],<ref name="PP" /> [[Project Protean]],<ref name="R" /> and [[Research Corps Eight]].<ref name="SD" />

The bureau managed multiple facilities across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] including the [[Imperial Science Bureau Cybernetic Research Center|Cybernetic Research Center]],<ref name="BaS" /> [[Project Protean laboratory]] in the [[Subterrel sector/Legends|Subterrel sector]],<ref name="PP" /> [[Quesh Geo-survey Station]], [[Taris Engineering Post]],<ref name="ST" /> and [[Special Energy Project Center]].<ref name="DitC">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Imperial|Descent into the Core|[[Makeb]]}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|The Empire has no higher priority. Nadrin&mdash;contact the Science Bureau. Bring in any outside help you need.|An Imperial hero attempts to help the Empire extract Makeb's isotope-5 deposits|<ref name="ST" />}}
Around [[3685 BBY]], as part of a joint initiative with [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], the Science Bureau chose a family for a project whereby they genetically altered a [[Youngling/Legends|child]] in the [[Womb/Legends|womb]] and subjected the [[Watcher X|child]] to a series of additional procedures during maturation. By adolescence, the child exhibited a keen mind and strong aptitude.<ref name="WatcherX">{{TORcite|type=codex|Intelligence Profile: Watcher X (Agent)}}</ref>

===Cold War===
{{Quote|Welcome to Project Hexapod. Not much, is it? Just me and a couple of obsolete computers. Empire's throwing all its resources into the war. What little good it does.|Doctor Revis introduces himself to Imperial heroes on Balmorra|<ref name="PH">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Project Hexapod|[[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]}}</ref>}}
[[File:Javelin_Dreadnought.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Science Bureau held the blueprints to the Javelin Dreadnought (pictured).]]
In [[3643 BBY]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Science Bureau possessed the blueprints for the [[Javelin Dreadnought]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="TLS">''[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 1]]''</ref>

{{GameDSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
During the [[Grathan's revolt|revolt]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Grathan]] against the [[Dark Council]] on the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], twenty [[Imperial soldier|Imperial soldiers]] assigned to observe Grathan's [[Lord Grathan's forces|forces]] disappeared and were later discovered by Imperial heroes in Grathan's manufacturing plant having been subjected to experimentation by Grathan's [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] whereby they had their [[Brain/Legends|brains]] removed from their bodies and placed in [[OHK-99|droids]]. The heroes used a command console to direct the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to return to loyal Imperial forces where the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers']] former [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sarnova]], revealed the Science Bureau wanted them for research.<ref name="TWM" />
{{Endgame}}

On the Imperial-occupied planet [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], Science Bureau [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Revis]] led [[Project Hexapod]] to analyze the weaponization of the [[Mutant|mutated]] [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the planet. Revis recruited Imperial heroes to enter the [[Farnel Outpost|Farnel science lab]] with a [[Computer spike/Legends|data spike]] to upload data on the experiments.<ref name="PH" />

On the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], two twin [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] brothers named [[Teek (Neimoidian)|Teek]] and [[Jeek]], both tier-six inventors of the Science Bureau's [[Research Corps Eight]], were engaged in separately field testing their inventions and procured the assistance of Imperial heroes to aid them. At Teek's direction, the heroes tested his shield destabilizer to destroy eight Mark V junk droids<ref name="SD" /> and ten other malfunctioning droids.<ref name="JaC">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Junkers and Clunkers|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> Later, Jeek had the heroes test his control core nullifier on four [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]], rendering them harmless.<ref name="CS">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Core Subversion|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

During the Cold War, they were responsible for getting the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] to assign [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Vector Hyllus]] assigned on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in order to get him to encounter the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] so that they could witness the process that transformed a sentient into a [[Joiner]]. This was all part of [[Project Protean]] that sought to find means to use [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species to enhance Imperial operatives by means of [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetic engineering]].<ref name="TS">{{TORcite|type=conversation|[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Eckard Lokin|Lokin]]|Test Subject}}</ref>

===Galactic War===
{{Dialogue|Nadrin Tro|After vigorous discussion, the Science Bureau has reached consensus on a plan to preserve Makeb.|Taris Scientist|The isotope-5 deposits in Makeb's core generate powerful gravitational and electromagnetic fields. Until recently, those fields maintained the core's equilibrium.|Energy Center Scientist|The, ah, rapid removal of isotope-5 caused the fields to fluctuate and destabilized the core. Now Makeb is tearing itself apart.|Nadrin Tro|It is now too late to reverse the destabilization process. Our only option is to accelerate it.|attr=Science Bureau scientists present a briefing on how to stabilize the planet Makeb to an Imperial strike team leader|src=<ref name="RD">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Imperial|Recruitment Day|[[Makeb]]}}</ref>}}
Around the start of the [[Galactic War]] in [[3641 BBY]],<ref name="3641BBY">{{TOR_dates|3}}</ref> the Science Bureau assisted the campaign of Sith Lord and contender for the [[Monarch of Alderaan|Alderaanian throne]] [[Serjay Thul]] to confront and contain the threat of the Killik [[Soros|Black Hive]] on Alderaan<ref name="TDP">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Devouring Plague|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref> by provisioning one of Thul's strike teams, the Imperial [[Special Tactics Group 41-Delta]] based out of [[Outpost Eudor]] in the planet's [[Kaamos Territory]], with a device called a [[Brood Totem]]. The totem was an experimental attraction device intended to lure Killiks to enemy territory. Imperial heroes assisted the mission by retrieving the device's components and defeating at least twenty Killiks<ref name="StS">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Subduing the Soros|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref> in the [[Soros Killik Burrows]] then deploying the assembled device at rival [[House of Organa|House Organa's]] [[Wardpost Thrantus]] and [[Organa Surveillance Camp|spy camp]] to provoke Killik attacks on Organa troops.<ref name="LA">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Lethal Attraction|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref> Separately, Science Bureau Doctor [[Imodin Ganalya]] led the [[Mother's Milk project]], the development of a serum to neutralize Killik [[Larva/Legends|larvae]]. After her team failed to test the serum on Killik [[Egg/Legends|eggs]], she obtained the assistance of Imperial heroes who recovered the serum in the field and poisoned ten egg clusters at the [[Sabas Killik Hives]].<ref name="E">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Exterminator|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref> While performing the mission, the heroes defeated at least twenty Killiks who opposed them,<ref name="S1I">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Stage 1 - Insecticide|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref> destroyed seven burrows,<ref name="S2I">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Stage 2 - Insecticide|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref> and eliminated the hive's [[Sabas Killik Queen|queen]] and her eggs.<ref name="FSI">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Final Stage - Insecticide|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref>

In [[3640 BBY]]<ref name="3640BBY">{{TOR_dates|Voss}}</ref> on the recently discovered planet [[Voss]], a Science Bureau research team code-named Project Chimera was studying the corrupting effects of the planet's [[Nightmare Lands]] region on offworld wildlife and observed unusual changes in several non-native life-forms imported to the planet. The project's findings were considered vital to Imperial operations on the planets [[Aaris III]] and [[Sebiris]]. Shortly after the team stopped responding to communications, the bureau sought any surviving data from the project's survey stations in the Nightmare Lands and issued a public notice and offer of reward to Imperial personnel on Voss. Imperial heroes accepted the mission, recovering and compiling data from three survey stations and attracting and retrieving samples from a corrupted [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slug]], [[Tuk'ata/Legends|tuk'ata]], and [[Shyrack/Legends|shyrack]]<ref name="PC" /> while defeating multiple indigenous [[Vorantikus|vorantiki]] and [[Mawvorr|crysfangs]].<ref name="NW">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Native Wildlife|[[Voss]]}}</ref>

The [[3639 BBY|following year]],<ref name="3639BBY">{{TOR_updates|1.1}}</ref> Republic [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] [[Operative|operatives]] raided a Science Bureau outpost on the planet [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] and recovered several variations of color [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] prototypes. At the Ilum outpost, the bureau's Project Expertise achieved a significant breakthrough in the crystal cutting process by which multiple variants of existing crystal colors which improved the crystal's natural properties were created.<ref name="ECiP115">{{TORweb|url=blog/economic-changes-patch-1.1.5|text=Economic Changes in Patch 1.1.5|date=2025-06-22}}</ref>

[[File:Mining Mesa.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Science Bureau plan to save the planet Makeb centered on using drilling platforms to accelerate the planet's destabilization.]]
[[Nadrin Tro]] and a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] of the bureau's [[New Thinking Division]] were sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] during the [[Conquest of Makeb]].<ref name="AWA" /> Under [[Katha Niar]], they worked to secure Makeb's [[isotope-5]] deposits for the Sith Empire. At an Imperial hero's command, Nadrin Tro contacted the Science Bureau for help in devising the plan to stabilize Makeb's planet core to buy [[Time/Legends|time]] for the Empire to extract the isotope-5 within.<ref name="ST" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The military has scientists, resources--someone should be able to aid them.''"<br />"''The Science Bureau wants them for research. Moff Ghorrin wants them for a special strike team. Whatever's left of their lives won't be pretty.|Optional dialogue between an Imperial player character and Captain Sarnova on Dromund Kaas|<ref name="TWM" />}}
The Imperial Science Bureau first appeared in the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[2011]]. Imperial player characters first encounter the organization on Dromund Kaas, the Imperial faction capital planet, in the mission The War Machine.<ref name="TWM" /> The organization primarily appears intermittently throughout the game in minor world missions but figures more prominently in companion conversations between the Imperial Agent player character and Doctor Lokin.<ref name="KtL" /> Some game updates and expansions have included brief appearances of the bureau with the group figuring most prominently in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' expansion.<ref name="AWA" />

===Alternate stories===
{{Quote|Ardun Kothe may be dead, but we can't leave the Shadow Arsenal in place.''"<br />"''Agreed. I'm sure the Minister of War and the Science Bureau will fight for possession....|Cipher Nine and Doctor Lokin discuss the fate of the Shadow Arsenal missiles on Quesh in optional dialogue|<ref name="TSA" />}}
In the mission The War Machine on Dromund Kaas, player characters have the Light side option of disabling the droids from the command console, killing them and putting the soldiers out of their misery.<ref name="TWM" />

At the conclusion of the Imperial planetary story arc on Tatooine, which focused on an [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] [[Reclamation Service Tatooine expedition|expedition]], player characters have the Dark side option to accept the offer of [[The Imprisoned One]] to work with the empire. In conversation options with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Barden Golah]] later, the officer states the Science Bureau will decide whether the Imprisoned One's [[The Imprisoned One's mind prison|mind prison]] will be opened if the player character cautions against it and also states that the bureau will demand the mind prison be transported to Dromund Kaas.<ref name="TTCF">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Thing Czerka Found|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> Later, players receive an in-game message from Golah where he lauds the contribution of the player character to the expedition's mission and details progress made by the Science Bureau in examining the mind prison.<ref name="TE/CB">{{TORcite|type=message|Tatooine Expedition / Czerka Box|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Barden Golah]]}}</ref>

At the conclusion of the Imperial Agent class story for Act II, if the player character decides to kill [[Ardun Kothe]] and has Dr. Lokin as the active companion when speculating about the fate of the [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] of the [[Shadow Arsenal]], Lokin suggests the Science Bureau and Imperial [[Minister of War (Sith Empire)|Minister of War]] will fight for possession.<ref name="TSA">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|The Shadow Arsenal|[[Quesh]]}}</ref>
